avis.titre: Painful Reaction on Neck After One Use
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this product, but unfortunately, it did not agree with my skin. I used it for the first time this morning, and just a few hours later I developed red, painful bumps all over my neck — exactly where I had sprayed it. The reaction came on quickly and felt more like burning/pain than itching. My skin is usually pretty tolerant and I've used other products with similar ingredients without issue, so I was surprised. After checking the label, I suspect it may have been the combination of lactic acid, ferments, and preservatives that triggered the irritation. The fact that it's a spray probably didn't help, since it spread over a sensitive area of my skin. I would not recommend.
